_doc: Rules for the HC compat config addon (tools/package/compat_addon.py, docs/tools/COMPAT_ADDON.md). The addon only fills config entries by inheritance; it never copies a dependency's class bodies, assets, scripts or text. own_rules come from this repo's own data and are empty today: our own CE types and config.cpp need no compat entry. dependency_rules is the slot for rules derived from native RPT evidence; each row is {id, section, class, parent, requires[], provider?, set{}, evidence} and requires/evidence are mandatory there. A rule that requires an optional (non-mandatory) addon needs a provider slot declared in providers [{slot, item}]; each slot becomes its own PBO built only when its Workshop item is declared. required_addons must name our own CfgPatches classes; the generator checks them against mods/*/config.cpp. Empty on 2026-11-22: the config 'No entry' rows in the newest RPT are nested sub-entries (DamageSystem, OpticsInfo, Beam) of vanilla and pack base classes, which this schema (top-level scalar properties on a class with a proven upstream parent) cannot and may not patch; see the doc.
